suggestion: Keep the written-rule standard for 'single entry' on every page
why: Three states, never two: CONFIRMED (a sheet says so), NO RULE STATED (sheet read, silent) and NOT READ. This series has 0 confirmed, 76 no-rule-stated rows and 7 events explicitly limited to one flight, which ends the 31/30/20/0 disagreement between earlier sessions.
decision_needed: Your choice: keep NO RULE STATED rows in the ranked list (current) or move them to a watchlist.

suggestion: Two phone calls sharpen the whole site
why: Venetian poker desk: the re-entry/add-on rule for the event numbers you plan to play. Wynn poker desk: do the daily tournaments run during WPT? Each answer becomes a sourced excerpt on the row, which is the only field missing for ranking and for the day plan.
decision_needed: Both numbers are printed on the official pages already linked.

suggestion: Turn the trip calculator into a per-night qualifier checker
why: The official Venetian poker rate requires 6 hours of cash play or a $300+ tournament buy-in each night. Every buy-in is in the dataset, so the planner can show whether a chosen day qualifies and price the night at the poker rate, or mark the rate unverified when it does not.
decision_needed: Approve the automatic check, and decide what to show for a non-qualifying night.

suggestion: Publish one site, not eleven dashboards
why: Each session published its own folder under the same URL, which is honest but unreadable. Move prior folders under /archive/ with a banner, or list them on a session index, and keep the root site as the single product.
decision_needed: Needs your approval; only an integration session should move another session's folder.

suggestion: Score hotel quality from a declared source, or drop the column
why: Cost and quality outrank distance in the brief, but no official page scores quality. Pick AAA diamonds or Forbes Travel Guide, record the rating with its date and URL, then rank on cost + rating; otherwise leave the column out so nothing is paraphrased from review sites.
decision_needed: Choose the rating source, or forbid quality ranking.

suggestion: Extend the morning monitor from 'source changed' to 'value changed'
why: The re-check job already re-reads every official URL, records a hash and marks rows whose source changed. The next step is to parse the schedule row and the sheet's Guarantee / Late Registration / Start Time lines and diff the parsed values, so a guarantee moving is reported rather than a hash change.
decision_needed: Approve the parse rules; a loose regex would report noise.

why: The Venetian page updates start times, results and cancellations. A nightly job that appends the parsed rows to a dated log would show whether an event you planned moved, filled or was cancelled, with the date it changed.
decision_needed: Decide whether the bot may commit to main without review.

suggestion: Show implied field size next to the ratio
why: Sheets state the guarantee and 'pays 12.5% of the field'. guarantee / (buy-in - house fee) / 0.125 gives the entries needed before the guarantee stops being a floor. That is arithmetic on published numbers, labelled as such - not a forecast of your result.
decision_needed: Approve showing this arithmetic, or keep ratios only.

suggestion: Make the walk filter a route log instead of a boolean
why: Store hotel, venue, mode, minutes, source and date per observation. One timed walk entered once is reused by every plan; pairs nobody has measured stay hidden by the 30-minute filter instead of showing an estimate.
decision_needed: Approve your own timed walks as a source class.

suggestion: Rank only events with both a confirmed entry fee and a confirmed guarantee
why: This is the rule the site enforces: 74 candidate rows carry both numbers, 4 events publish no guarantee at all and are excluded from the ranking (F39), and satellites guarantee seats so they are ranked separately (F40). Keeping it means no row is ever filled from memory or a third-party page.
decision_needed: Nothing to do - a rule worth keeping.

suggestion: Add the WPT rows to the day plan once you pick the hotel
why: The WPT schedule rows are now in the dataset with dates, starts, stacks and level lengths, so if you stay at Wynn/Encore the same primary-plus-fallback logic can run across both rooms - but no verified walk time between the two properties exists yet (F43), which is why they are not combined into one day today.
decision_needed: Pick the hotel first; combining rooms needs the walk measured.
